chemistry.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists the LYRIQ-V cells as GM Ultium 140Ah NMC pouch (GM calls them NCMA, closest enum nmc); same Ultium cells across all LYRIQ trims and years.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Cadillac's DC fast-charging support page (cadillac.com returns 403; a search excerpt was seen earlier but the checker could not reproduce it) is said to describe automatic preconditioning when routing to a DC fast charger with built-in Google navigation, and a manual Fast Charge Prep in the app. UNVERIFIED: not read on a page for this model year; assumed for all LYRIQ years on the same Ultium software.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: KBB lists battery capacity 102.00 kWh for all 2026 Lyriq trims (relaying Cadillac's 102 kWh). A bare capacity is treated as gross. Wikipedia says every LYRIQ and LYRIQ-V uses the same 102 kWh pack (2023-2027).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia: 102 kWh gross, 100 kWh usable; Auto-data gives net 100.4 kWh. Same 102 kWh pack across LYRIQ years and trims (years on this powertrain: 2027).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: GreenCarsCompare states the Lyriq is built on a 400 V architecture (aggregator, no model-year split); same 102 kWh pack across 2023-2027 (Wikipedia and Electrek show no pack change).

published_10_80_min.notes: Cadillac says 10-80% in about 40 min at a public DC fast charger (CarGurus; The Charge Port repeats it for LYRIQ and LYRIQ-V). Model-level claim.

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: GreenCarsCompare gives 190 kW DC for the Lyriq; InsideEVs (2023, Cadillac figure) and Electrek (2027) both state 190 kW, same pack and charger hardware 2023-2027 with no change found. Model year 2026.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: GreenCarsCompare: 11.5 kW AC standard, 19.2 kW optional (powertrain records the standard charger; 19.2 kW is captured per trim where NRCan/EPA name it). Aggregator figure, not attributed to Cadillac.
